text: Close the security findings of the 2026-11-09 read-only hosting audit before any public instance
description:
Audit 2026-11-09 of everything an anonymous visitor reaches on a hosted instance (37 read-role procedures computed from appRouter + neededRole, /mcp proxy, HTTP routes, frontend sinks, pnpm audit).

HIGH 1. idea.commitDiff (anonymous) runs `git show --patch <hex>` on the whole repository: full diffs of any commit in the server clone's history, code and any secret ever committed included. Verified: getCommitDiff(.bowman, bf5933d9) returns packages/frontend/... files. commitEvidence hands out the hashes. Fix: host a sparse .bowman-only clone (as openGitRepository already does) AND restrict the diff to `-- <bowman dir>`; also covers reconcile_code_presence (MCP git grep over code = oracle on private code).

MEDIUM 2. Anonymous resource exhaustion, no rate limit anywhere: tRPC HTTP has no maxBodySize, ws maxPayload default 100 MiB; idea.searchSemantic unbounded query string -> local embedding CPU; project.buildSearchIndex (read-role mutation) re-indexes + backfills embeddings; graphHealth.findDuplicates/graphHygiene accept threshold 0 (n^2 pairs); activity.record takes arbitrary strings (not uuids, 5000 per call, unlimited calls) into memory and runtime/idea-activity.json; MCP /mcp/sse has unlimited sessions, each opening a backend WebSocket. pnpm audit: body-parser DoS (high) in the MCP SDK's express, exposed via /mcp/messages; zod oversized-collection memory exhaustion (high, advisory <4.6.6, backend on 3.25.76).
MEDIUM 3 (accounts with write role only). Path traversal: idea.create supportedIdeas[] and supportingConnections[].ideaId are z.string(), reach connectIdeasInternal -> readIdea -> path.join(dir, `${id}.json`); writeIdea writes to `${idea.id}.json`. Fix: uuid in every id schema plus an id-format guard inside readIdea/writeIdea.
LOW 4. NODE_ENV is unset in the hosted launch, so tRPC error responses carry stack traces; git.status returns the server's repositoryPath; linkedRepo.list/resolve return server localPaths.
LOW 5. activity.record lets anonymous viewers broadcast fake agent/edit activity to every viewer.
LOW 6. mcp/src/sse.ts listens on all interfaces when MCP_BIND_HOST is unset (the launcher sets 127.0.0.1; the code default should be loopback too).

VERIFIED SOLID: every procedure passes accessMiddleware (no t.procedure bypass); unlisted mutations need admin; loop/watchdog/system/voice/market/spinOff refused hosted; projectPath must equal the hosted project exactly (toBowmanPath does not resolve `..`, no bypass); MCP calls carry the caller's token through the same middleware, and its git tools run only after a backend call with the same projectPath succeeded; read-path ids are uuid-validated (suggestReparents' free string is only a map lookup); no v-html/innerHTML sinks in the frontend; scrypt + timingSafeEqual; agent cookie HttpOnly + SameSite=Strict + origin check; launcher binds MCP and broker to loopback; sirv serves only frontend/dist.
NOT COVERED: nginx/TLS config, the wrapped-agents broker (off unless AIMPARENCY_AGENTS), local non-hosted mode beyond loopback binding.

status.comment:
Fixed 2026-11-09 in 38e428c3, ed16c952, 270d37db and the README nginx rate limit:
#1 commitDiff only accepts commits (`<hash>^{commit}`, no blob/tree content) and, hosted, shows only the served .bowman.
#3 one id guard (storage/json.ts entityFile) on every idea/phase file path, which also closes history.restore (write role could write or delete any *.json); uuid ids in idea.create and activity.record.
#4 no stack traces when hosted or in production (tRPC isDev).
#6 MCP SSE binds MCP_BIND_HOST || BIND_HOST || 127.0.0.1 and refuses foreign browser origins (was all interfaces + open CORS in local dev:full / dev:host, acting with full local rights).
#2 8 MiB cap on HTTP bodies and WebSocket messages; queries max 2000 chars; graph-health limits max 500; MCP max 50 sessions; hosted, buildSearchIndex and activity.record need the write role (also ends #5 spoofing); body-parser, qs, undici, fast-uri updated (audit 14 -> 2); README nginx example now has limit_req (20 r/s, burst 200).
Low path leaks: hosted, git.status repositoryPath and linkedRepo localPath only for admins.
Evidence: auth.test, git-evidence.test, storage/json.test, backend 161/161, pnpm check 25/25, validate:local-runtime PASS.

Remaining: zod v3 -> v4 (audit high, oversized collections; bounded by the 8 MiB cap; a major upgrade across 6 packages), and serving a .bowman-only sparse clone as defence in depth, which belongs to the read-only design questions on 06d83e94.
